name: American Metal Fabricators
old_description: American Metal Fabricators has a proven history fabricating with a variety of materials including steel, stainless steel, and aluminum.
about:
American Metal Fabricators was founded in 1988 in Gastonia, North Carolina, just outside Charlotte. The company operates as a custom metal fabrication shop and has served the region for over three decades. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company fabricates a wide range of custom equipment including air washers, air handling units, foam panels, energy recovery systems, dryers, ovens, furnaces, plenums, duct systems, dust filtration equipment, gas turbine filtration, mining equipment, humidification systems, mist eliminators, acoustic enclosures, scrubbers, spray systems, and evaporative cooling systems. It operates from a 200,000-square-foot manufacturing facility with a dedicated 30,000-square-foot sandblast building, high-bay overhead cranes, and drive-through truck access. The workforce includes welders, fabricators, pipefitters, electricians, machinists, painters, mechanics, designers, drafters, schedulers, expediters, QA/QC inspectors, and sales staff. Equipment includes 15 press brakes (up to 14 feet, 400+ tons), five shears (1/2-inch capacity, 12 feet), four plasma cutting tables (10 feet wide by 40 feet long), laser cutters, a 500-foot rail paint line with downdraft booth, foam panel injection equipment, and rolling capabilities for angle ring, pipe, and channel.

American Metal Fabricators serves industries such as power generation, utilities, microelectronics, paper, pulp, fibers, textiles, wood, furniture, food and beverage, chemicals, plastics, paint, printing, heavy equipment, and pharmaceuticals. Customers include utilities, industrial equipment manufacturers, and facilities requiring custom metal enclosures and filtration systems.

The company emphasizes its ability to handle complex jobs with short lead times, supported by a large skilled labor force that allows rapid expansion. It is equipped for both large-scale projects and special handling of smaller orders, with in-house capabilities spanning welding, forming, blasting, painting, rolling, assembly, and foam panel manufacturing.
